name: English single-page site with all sections
purpose: No site file exists. None of the nav, Adopt, Donate, Volunteer or Success Stories content exists.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the file lacks any of the 5 nav anchors or the volunteer form after 4 model calls or 40 minutes, and report to Coordination; no extra money is released.

completion_check: File has the viewport tag, the 5 nav anchors, at least 3 sample pets each with name/species/age/description and a wa.me or mailto inquiry button, a Donate block with placeholders and no payment script or card input, a volunteer form with labelled name/phone/email/availability fields whose submit builds a wa.me or mailto link, no external form action and no storage code, and at least 3 stories each with a pet name and text.

name: Kannada version with language toggle
purpose: The site is English-only, with no toggle, Kannada text, Kannada font or review notice.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any visible string still lacks a Kannada version after 3 model calls or 30 minutes, and report to Coordination; no extra money is released.

completion_check: Toggle is reachable by keyboard, every text element has an English and a Kannada string, a Kannada-capable font is loaded, html lang changes to kn and back to en on toggle, and the pending-review notice is visible in both modes.
